name: sorceress_generate_model
description: Generate a 3D model (GLB) from an image or a text prompt and save it into the project (default assets/sorceress/models). Models: 'hunyuan3d-3.1' (image-to-3D only), 'tripo-v3.1' and 'meshy-6' (text- OR image-to-3D). For image-to-3D, FIRST create a reference image with sorceress_generate_image, then pass that image's URL as imageUrl here. Credits are charged to the API key owner only on success; cost varies by model/mode/options (Hunyuan ~30, Tripo ~45-50, Meshy ~45). Call sorceress_list_tools for exact costs. Waits for completion and returns the saved .glb path.

prompt.description: Text description for text-to-3D (tripo-v3.1 / meshy-6 only).

imageUrl.description: https image URL for image-to-3D (required for hunyuan3d-3.1). Use a URL returned by sorceress_generate_image.

imageUrls.description: Multiple https image URLs for multi-view (tripo-v3.1 / meshy-6). Up to 4, ordered front, left, back, right.

params.description: Model-specific options that can affect cost (e.g. Meshy {"should_texture":true,"should_remesh":false}; Tripo {"texture":"HD","quad":false}).
